<b>Balm for the Wounded</b> is a [[Wayfarer Wishes|Wayfarer Wish]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>.

== How to Start ==
The wish can be acquired from [[Songclave]]'s [[wishwall]] after meeting [[Sherma]] in Songclave and visiting the [[Whiteward]].

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Jubilana 01.png!Wishwall's location in the Choral Chambers
|Image2 = Screenshot SS Jubilana 01.png!Wishwall in Songclave
}}

== Wish ==
To complete the wish, [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] must locate Sherma, who has gone to the Whiteward in search of medical supplies. Upon promising the wish, a small doorway opens in the eastern part of the Whiteward, granting access to a room where Sherma can be found.

Upon talking to Sherma, Hornet is ambushed by the [[Enemy Gauntlets (Silksong)/Whiteward 1|enemy gauntlet]]. Defeating the enemies and talking to Sherma once more completes the wish.

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Sherma 08.png!Sherma's location in the Whiteward
|Image2 = Screenshot SS Sherma 05.png!Sherma in the Whiteward
}}

== Reward ==
[[File:Spool Fragment.png|link=Spool Fragment|left|thumb|100x100px]]

After completing the wish, Sherma gifts Hornet a [[Spool Fragment]] that he found within the Whiteward. He then returns to Songclave.

{{Clear}}
